# generate-webhook

Generate OpenAPI 3.1 Webhook specifications with full subscription lifecycle,
HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, retry policies, and idempotency key
management from a Linear issue description.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when the issue mentions any of:
- Webhook registration, subscription, or callback URLs
- SaaS integration event delivery (Stripe, GitHub, Twilio patterns)
- HMAC signature verification, payload signing
- Retry policies, exponential backoff, dead letter
- Idempotency keys, deduplication
- External system event notifications

## Input

| Field | Source | Required |
|-------|--------|----------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear issue ID (e.g., `UPT-55`) | ✅ |
| `issue.title` | Linear issue title | ✅ |
| `issue.description` | Full issue body — integration context, event types, external systems | ✅ |
| `issue.labels` | Labels array | ✅ |
| `workspace` | Absolute path to workspace root | ✅ |
| `direction` | `inbound` / `outbound` / `both` — override auto-detection | optional |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
  webhook/
    {domain}-webhooks.yaml        # OpenAPI 3.1 + Callbacks (primary)
    schemas/
      {EventType}Payload.json     # JSON Schema per event type
    examples/
      {EventType}.example.json    # Request/response examples
```

Every generated file starts with:

```yaml
# Generated by Uptempo for {issue.identifier}: {issue.title}
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Issue Context

1. Extract external system names, event types, and data flow direction.
2. Detect direction:
   | Signal | Direction |
   |--------|-----------|
   | "receive events from", "listen for", "inbound" | `inbound` |
   | "notify", "send events to", "dispatch", "outbound" | `outbound` |
   | Both signals present | `both` |
3. If ambiguous, default to **inbound** (receiving webhooks is the more common case).
4. Identify event types from description (e.g., `order.created`, `payment.failed`).

### Step 2 — Design Subscription Lifecycle

Define the four-phase lifecycle:

```
1. Register   POST /webhooks/subscriptions
2. Verify     GET  {callback_url}?challenge={token}
3. Receive    POST {callback_url}  (with signature headers)
4. Unsubscribe DELETE /webhooks/subscriptions/{id}
```

For **outbound** webhooks, also define:
- Delivery status tracking: `GET /webhooks/deliveries/{id}`
- Manual retry: `POST /webhooks/deliveries/{id}/retry`

### Step 3 — Build OpenAPI 3.1 Document

Produce `{workspace}/webhook/{domain}-webhooks.yaml`:

```yaml
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: "{domain} Webhook API"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "{issue.identifier}: {issue.title}"
  x-generated-by: uptempo

paths:
  /webhooks/subscriptions:
    post:
      operationId: createWebhookSubscription
      summary: "Register a webhook subscription"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/WebhookSubscriptionRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: "Subscription created"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WebhookSubscription"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
        "409":
          description: "Duplicate subscription URL"
      callbacks:
        {eventType}:
          "{$request.body#/url}":
            post:
              summary: "Deliver {eventType} event"
              requestBody:
                content:
                  application/json:
                    schema:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/{EventType}Payload"
              responses:
                "200":
                  description: "Event accepted"
                "410":
                  description: "Endpoint gone — unsubscribe"

    get:
      operationId: listWebhookSubscriptions
      summary: "List active subscriptions"
      parameters:
        - name: event_type
          in: query
          schema: { type: string }
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageCursor"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Subscription list"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WebhookSubscriptionList"

  /webhooks/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}:
    delete:
      operationId: deleteWebhookSubscription
      summary: "Unsubscribe"
      parameters:
        - name: subscriptionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "204":
          description: "Unsubscribed"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"

webhooks:
  {eventType}:
    post:
      operationId: "webhook.{eventType}"
      summary: "Receive {eventType} event"
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/WebhookSignature"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/WebhookTimestamp"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/WebhookEvent"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/WebhookDeliveryId"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/{EventType}Payload"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Accepted"

components:
  parameters:
    WebhookSignature:
      name: X-Webhook-Signature
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, pattern: "^sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}$" }
      description: "HMAC-SHA256 signature: sha256=hex(HMAC(secret, timestamp.payload))"
    WebhookTimestamp:
      name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string }
      description: "Unix epoch seconds — reject if > 300s old (replay protection)"
    WebhookEvent:
      name: X-Webhook-Event
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string }
    WebhookDeliveryId:
      name: X-Webhook-Delivery
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      description: "Unique delivery ID — use as idempotency key"
    PageCursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema: { type: string }

  schemas:
    WebhookSubscriptionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [url, events, secret]
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: "HTTPS callback URL"
        events:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
          minItems: 1
          description: "Event types to subscribe to"
        secret:
          type: string
          minLength: 32
          description: "Shared secret for HMAC signing"
      additionalProperties: false

    WebhookSubscription:
      type: object
      required: [id, url, events, status, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        url: { type: string, format: uri }
        events: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        status: { type: string, enum: [active, paused, disabled] }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }

    WebhookSubscriptionList:
      type: object
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WebhookSubscription" }
        nextCursor: { type: string, nullable: true }

  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: "Request validation failed"
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              error: { type: string }
              details: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
    NotFound:
      description: "Resource not found"
```

### Step 4 — Define Signature Verification

Include the verification algorithm as `x-webhook-security` extension:

```yaml
x-webhook-security:
  algorithm: HMAC-SHA256
  header: X-Webhook-Signature
  format: "sha256={hex_digest}"
  signed-payload: "{timestamp}.{raw_body}"
  replay-window-seconds: 300
  verification-pseudocode: |
    signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.{raw_body}"
    expected = hmac_sha256(secret, signed_payload)
    valid = constant_time_compare(f"sha256={expected}", signature_header)
    fresh = abs(now() - int(timestamp)) < 300
    return valid and fresh
```

### Step 5 — Configure Retry Policy

Add `x-webhook-retry` extension to the spec:

```yaml
x-webhook-retry:
  max-attempts: 5
  backoff: exponential
  base-delay-ms: 1000
  max-delay-ms: 60000
  jitter: true
  retry-on: [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
  dead-letter:
    enabled: true
    max-age-hours: 72
    endpoint: "/webhooks/dead-letter"
```

### Step 6 — Invoke Generator

```bash
cd {workspace}
python -m uptempo.schema.webhook \
  --issue-id "{issue.identifier}" \
  --workspace "{workspace}" \
  --direction "{inbound|outbound|both}" \
  --domain "{domain}"
```

The generator (`src/uptempo/schema/webhook.py`) implements `SchemaGenerator`:
- `generate(issue, workspace)` → writes files, returns `list[Path]`
- `validate(files)` → runs Spectral lint, returns error list

### Step 7 — Validate

```bash
# Lint with Spectral
npx @stoplight/spectral-cli lint {workspace}/webhook/{domain}-webhooks.yaml \
  --ruleset .spectral.yaml

# Validate JSON Schema payloads
npx ajv validate -s {schema_file} -d /dev/null --strict=true

# Verify all $ref pointers resolve
npx swagger-cli validate {workspace}/webhook/{domain}-webhooks.yaml
```

Pass criteria:
- Zero Spectral errors (warnings acceptable)
- All `$ref` pointers resolve
- Every webhook has all four signature headers defined
- Every callback response includes `200` and `410` status codes
- `WebhookSubscriptionRequest` enforces `secret.minLength >= 32`

## Idempotency Key Contract

```
Header: X-Webhook-Delivery: {uuid}
```

- Each delivery attempt for the same event uses the **same** delivery ID
- Consumer deduplicates by storing processed delivery IDs (TTL: 72 hours)
- On retry, the delivery ID remains constant — only the attempt count increments

## Security Checklist

- [ ] HTTPS-only callback URLs (`format: uri` + runtime `https://` check)
- [ ] HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time comparison
- [ ] Timestamp-based replay protection (300s window)
- [ ] Secret minimum 32 characters
- [ ] IP allowlisting documented in `x-webhook-security.ip-allowlist`
- [ ] Rate limiting on subscription creation

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Direction ambiguous | Default to `inbound`, set `x-direction-assumed: inbound` |
| No event types in issue | Generate CRUD lifecycle events, set `x-auto-derived: true` |
| External system unnamed | Use generic Webhook pattern (GitHub/Stripe convention), note in `x-reference-pattern` |
| Spectral lint fails | Return errors to agent for correction, retry once |
| Mixed inbound + outbound | Generate separate path groups with clear directional labels |

- **realtime-engineer**: Align webhook event types with SSE/WebSocket push topics
